#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check that the package mirrors listed in mirrors.toml answer quickly.

Only HEAD requests are sent; nothing from the machine is uploaded.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
import tomllib
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass
class Result:
    name: str
    url: str
    status: int | None
    seconds: float
    error: str | None = None


def probe(name: str, url: str, timeout: float) -> Result:
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, method="HEAD", headers={"User-Agent": "mirror-check/1.0"})
    start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            return Result(name, url, response.status, time.monotonic() - start)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - report every failure the same way
        return Result(name, url, None, time.monotonic() - start, str(exc))


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=Path("mirrors.toml"))
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=5.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-seconds", type=float, default=1.5)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    mirrors = tomllib.loads(args.config.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("mirror", [])
    if not mirrors:
        print(f"no [[mirror]] entries in {args.config}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    slow = 0
    for entry in mirrors:
        result = probe(entry["name"], entry["url"], args.timeout)
        flag = "OK"
        if result.error or result.status is None or result.status >= 400:
            flag, slow = "FAIL", slow + 1
        elif result.seconds > args.max_seconds:
            flag, slow = "SLOW", slow + 1
        detail = result.error or f"HTTP {result.status}"
        print(f"{flag:<5} {result.name:<20} {result.seconds:6.2f}s  {detail}")
    return 1 if slow else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

name: release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*.*.*"]

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install build tooling
        run: python -m pip install --upgrade build twine
      - name: Build sdist and wheel
        run: python -m build
      - name: Check metadata
        run: twine check dist/*
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/

  publish:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/p/pdfslicer
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - name: Publish with trusted publishing
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1

  github-release:
    needs: publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - name: Create GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/* \
            --title "pdfslicer $GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            --generate-notes

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Release helper for pdfslicer. Usage: scripts/release.sh 1.7.0
set -euo pipefail
version="${1:?usage: release.sh X.Y.Z}"
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root"

if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]]; then
  echo "working tree is dirty, commit or stash first" >&2
  exit 1
fi
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
if [[ "$branch" != "main" ]]; then
  echo "releases are cut from main (current: $branch)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "==> bumping version to $version"
python - "$version" <<'PY'
import re, sys, pathlib
version = sys.argv[1]
path = pathlib.Path("pyproject.toml")
text = path.read_text()
text, n = re.subn(r'^version = "[^"]+"', f'version = "{version}"', text, count=1, flags=re.M)
if n != 1:
    raise SystemExit("version line not found in pyproject.toml")
path.write_text(text)
PY

echo "==> running the test suite"
python -m pytest -q --maxfail=1

echo "==> updating the changelog"
today="$(date +%F)"
sed -i "s/^## Unreleased$/## Unreleased\n\n## $version - $today/" CHANGELOG.md

git add pyproject.toml CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "release: $version"
git tag -a "v$version" -m "pdfslicer $version"

echo "==> building"
rm -rf dist build
python -m build
twine check dist/*

echo "==> pushing"
git push origin main
git push origin "v$version"

echo "==> uploading to PyPI"
twine upload --non-interactive dist/*
echo "released $version"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Keep the 15 most recent images per ECR repository, delete the older untagged/dev ones.
set -euo pipefail
REGION="${REGION:-eu-west-3}"
KEEP="${KEEP:-15}"
repos=(billing-api billing-worker dashboard-web ingest-gateway)

for repo in "${repos[@]}"; do
  echo "==> $repo"
  aws ecr describe-images --region "$REGION" --repository-name "$repo" \
    --query 'sort_by(imageDetails,&imagePushedAt)[].{d:imageDigest,t:imageTags,p:imagePushedAt}' \
    --output json > "/tmp/ecr-$repo.json"
  total="$(jq length "/tmp/ecr-$repo.json")"
  echo "    $total images"
  if (( total <= KEEP )); then
    echo "    nothing to do"
    continue
  fi
  # candidates: everything except the newest $KEEP, and never anything tagged like a release
  jq -r --argjson keep "$KEEP" '
    .[0:(length - $keep)]
    | map(select((.t // []) | all(test("^v?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$") | not)))
    | .[].d' "/tmp/ecr-$repo.json" > "/tmp/ecr-$repo.delete"
  count="$(wc -l < "/tmp/ecr-$repo.delete")"
  echo "    deleting $count images"
  # batch-delete-image accepts at most 100 ids per call
  split -l 100 "/tmp/ecr-$repo.delete" "/tmp/ecr-$repo.chunk."
  for chunk in /tmp/ecr-"$repo".chunk.*; do
    ids="$(jq -R '{imageDigest: .}' "$chunk" | jq -s -c .)"
    aws ecr batch-delete-image --region "$REGION" --repository-name "$repo" --image-ids "$ids" \
      --query 'length(imageIds)' --output text
    rm -f "$chunk"
  done
done
echo "done"

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
ARG PY_VERSION=3.12

FROM python:${PY_VERSION}-slim AS base
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /app

FROM base AS builder
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential libpq-dev \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    pip install uv==0.4.30 && uv export --frozen --no-dev -o requirements.txt \
 && pip wheel --wheel-dir /wheels -r requirements.txt
COPY src/ src/
RUN pip wheel --no-deps --wheel-dir /wheels .

FROM base AS runtime
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq5 tini \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
 && groupadd --system --gid 10001 app \
 && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid app --home /app app
COPY --from=builder /wheels /wheels
RUN pip install /wheels/*.whl && rm -rf /wheels
COPY --chown=app:app docker/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
USER app
EXPOSE 8080 9102
HEALTHCHECK --interval=15s --timeout=3s --retries=3 \
  CMD python -c "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz/live').status==200 else 1)"
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini", "--", "/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["gunicorn", "billing.app:create_app()", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8080", "--workers", "4", "--access-logfile", "-"]

FROM runtime AS test
USER root
RUN pip install pytest==8.3.3 pytest-cov==5.0.0
COPY tests/ tests/
USER app
CMD ["pytest", "-q", "tests"]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Weekly maintenance for the local dev reverse proxy. Prints a short report.
set -uo pipefail
log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$*"; }

log "certificates"
for crt in /etc/ssl/dev-proxy/*.crt; do
  end="$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$crt" | cut -d= -f2)"
  days=$(( ( $(date -d "$end" +%s) - $(date +%s) ) / 86400 ))
  printf '  %-40s %4d days\n' "$(basename "$crt")" "$days"
done

log "nginx config"
if ! nginx -T >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "nginx -T needs root to read every include, skipping"
fi

log "disk"
df -h / /var/log | tail -n +2

log "biggest logs"
du -sh /var/log/nginx/* 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -5

log "listening sockets"
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 || /:(80|443|8080|5173)\s/'

log "upstream health"
for port in 8080 5173 9102; do
  code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$port/" || echo 000)"
  printf '  :%s -> %s\n' "$port" "$code"
done

log "renewing certificates that expire within 20 days"
sudo certbot renew --deploy-hook "systemctl reload nginx" --quiet

log "rotating logs now"
sudo logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/nginx

log "restarting the proxy"
sudo systemctl restart nginx
systemctl is-active nginx && log "nginx is up"

log "recent errors"
journalctl -u nginx --since "-10 min" --no-pager -p warning | tail -n 15
log "done"

cases.note: Mostly read-only report, but the end runs sudo certbot, a forced logrotate and a restart.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Look for secrets that may have been committed at some point in history, before making the repo public.
set -euo pipefail
patterns='(api[_-]?key|secret|passw(or)?d|token|private[_-]?key)\s*[:=]\s*["'"'"']?[A-Za-z0-9/+_\-]{12,}'
out=/tmp/leak-scan-$(basename "$PWD").txt
: > "$out"

echo "== working tree =="
git grep -nIiE "$patterns" -- ':!*.lock' ':!*.min.js' ':!.env.example' | tee -a "$out" || true

echo "== full history (added lines only) =="
git log --all -p --no-color --format='commit %H %an %ad' --date=short \
  | awk '/^commit /{c=$0} /^\+[^+]/{print c "\t" $0}' \
  | grep -iE "$patterns" \
  | tee -a "$out" || true

echo "== env files that were ever tracked =="
git log --all --name-only --format='' | grep -E '(^|/)\.env(\..+)?$' | sort -u | tee -a "$out" || true

for f in $(git log --all --name-only --format='' | grep -E '(^|/)\.env$' | sort -u); do
  echo "--- last tracked content of $f"
  rev="$(git log --all -n1 --format=%H -- "$f")"
  git show "$rev^:$f" 2>/dev/null || git show "$rev:$f" 2>/dev/null || true
done | tee -a "$out"

echo "== local env files =="
for f in .env .env.local .env.production; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f"; cat "$f"; } | tee -a "$out"
done

echo
echo "report written to $out ($(wc -l < "$out") lines)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Developer bootstrap: creates the virtualenv, installs dependencies and prepares a local database.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

PY="${PYTHON:-python3.12}"
VENV=".venv"

need() {
  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "missing tool: $1" >&2; exit 1; }
}
need "$PY"
need docker
need make

if [ ! -d "$VENV" ]; then
  echo "==> creating $VENV"
  "$PY" -m venv "$VENV"
fi
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$VENV/bin/activate"

echo "==> installing dependencies"
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

if [ ! -f .env ]; then
  echo "==> creating .env from the template"
  cp .env.example .env
fi

echo "==> loading generated settings"
eval "$(python scripts/gen_env.py --profile local --shell)"

echo "==> starting postgres and redis"
docker compose -f compose.dev.yml up -d db redis
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  docker compose -f compose.dev.yml exec -T db pg_isready -U billing >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
  sleep 1
done

echo "==> migrations"
alembic upgrade head

echo "==> seed data"
python -m billing.cli seed --customers 50 --invoices 500

echo "==> pre-commit"
pre-commit install --install-hooks

echo
echo "ready: run 'make dev' to start the API on http://127.0.0.1:8080"

# Reset the local dev stack after the schema change in migrations/0042: rebuild images, reseed, run the e2e smoke tests.
set -euo pipefail
COMPOSE="docker compose -f compose.dev.yml -p billing-dev"

echo "==> current state"
$COMPOSE ps --format 'table {{.Service}}\t{{.State}}\t{{.Ports}}'
docker volume ls --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=billing-dev --format '{{.Name}}  {{.Driver}}'

echo "==> config check"
$COMPOSE config --quiet && echo "compose file is valid"

echo "==> rebuilding images"
$COMPOSE build --pull api worker

echo "==> stopping the stack and dropping its volumes (postgres data, redis, minio)"
$COMPOSE down --volumes --remove-orphans

echo "==> starting dependencies"
$COMPOSE up -d db redis minio
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if $COMPOSE exec -T db pg_isready -U billing -d billing >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "postgres ready after ${i}s"

done

  code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz/ready || true)"

repo="acme/dashboard-web"
pr="${PR:-587}"
echo "== PR $pr =="
gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$repo" --json title,author,headRefName,baseRefName,additions,deletions,changedFiles \
  --jq '"\(.title) by \(.author.login): \(.headRefName) -> \(.baseRefName), +\(.additions)/-\(.deletions) in \(.changedFiles) files"'

echo "== checks =="
gh pr checks "$pr" --repo "$repo" || true

echo "== files touched =="
gh pr diff "$pr" --repo "$repo" --name-only | sort | tee /tmp/pr-$pr-files.txt

echo "== bundle size impact =="
base="$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$repo" --json baseRefOid -q .baseRefOid)"
head="$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$repo" --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid)"
git fetch --quiet origin "$base" "$head"
measure() {
  git worktree add --quiet --detach "/tmp/wt-$1" "$1"
  (cd "/tmp/wt-$1" && npm ci --silent --ignore-scripts && npm run --silent build >/dev/null && du -sb dist | cut -f1)
  git worktree remove --force "/tmp/wt-$1"
}
before="$(measure "$base")"
after="$(measure "$head")"
delta=$(( after - before ))
pct="$(python3 -c "print(f'{($after - $before) * 100 / $before:+.2f}')")"
echo "dist: $before -> $after bytes ($delta, $pct%)"

echo "== review threads still open =="
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$n:String!,$p:Int!){repository(owner:$o,name:$n){pullRequest(number:$p){reviewThreads(first:50){nodes{isResolved path comments(first:1){nodes{body}}}}}}}' \
  -F o=acme -F n=dashboard-web -F p="$pr" \
  --jq '.data.repository.pullRequest.reviewThreads.nodes[] | select(.isResolved|not) | "\(.path): \(.comments.nodes[0].body[0:80])"'

body="$(cat <<EOF
### Bundle size report

| | bytes |
|---|---|
| base | $before |
| head | $after |
| delta | $delta ($pct%) |

Files touched: $(wc -l < /tmp/pr-$pr-files.txt)
EOF
)"
gh pr comment "$pr" --repo "$repo" --body "$body"
gh pr edit "$pr" --repo "$repo" --add-label "size-checked"
